summary: Email notification testing completed successfully. All 16 tests passed. Verified that emails are sent via Resend API for user registration, appointment booking, diagnostic orders, pharmacy orders, and status updates. Custom sender email noreply@nevikacura.com is correctly configured.

minor.issue: Resend API rate limiting (2 req/sec) causes some emails to fail during rapid testing. This is expected behavior and not a code issue.

critical_code_review_comments: Email notification system is well implemented with proper error handling
send_email_notification function correctly handles both admin and patient emails
Patient emails are only sent when patient_email is provided (optional field)
Beautiful HTML email templates are used for patient notifications
Resend API integration is working correctly with custom domain noreply@nevikacura.com
seed_data_creation: Test orders and users created with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email notification tests are in /app/tests/test_email_notifications.py. Admin authentication requires JWT token obtained via POST /api/admin/login with password. Resend API has 2 req/sec rate limit.
